claims.statement: EU rules require a battery passport from 18 February 2027 for LMT, EV, and industrial batteries above 2 kWh, including individual performance and use information.
Demand hypothesis: distributors and financiers will pay for one operational bridge because passport data can support warranty, reuse, and risk decisions beyond basic compliance.

contrary_evidence: Passport operators may provide claim features directly.
The mandatory passport date is future-facing and implementation details may evolve.

economics.acquisition_route: Integrate with two storage distributors before offering an insurer-facing portfolio feed.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 100000 tracked batteries at 40 PLN yearly plus claims revenue can support founder equity above 5 million PLN in five to seven years.
economics.founder_time: Four hours daily during standards and integration work.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 85% margin for API normalization and dossier generation.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 3000 paid battery records cover the initial build in eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 20-60 PLN per commissioned battery yearly plus 1-3% of recovered claim value.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Each battery remains tracked through service, warranty, ownership, and end-of-life events.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A longitudinal state-of-health and claim-outcome dataset improves anomaly and residual-value models.
fingerprint.customer: Battery distributors, storage installers, lessors, and specialty insurers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Battery distributors and financing providers embed it at commissioning and ownership transfer.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: An API normalizes passport, BMS, service, and ownership data into claim and transfer dossiers.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A distributor or lessor pays per passported battery and per resolved exception.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A capacity drop, thermal event, recall, or resale requires trustworthy identity and usage history.

founder_fit: The founder has renewable-channel access and strong data skills.
A standards-driven API can be built part-time before scaling integrations.
risks: OEM data permissions could block full lifecycle visibility.
Battery incidents create product-liability and cybersecurity exposure.

structure.control_point: The battery identity and signed lifecycle event record.
structure.critical_dependency: Permissioned access to passport, BMS, and service data.

thesis: A battery passport bridge can convert lifecycle events into warranty, recall, residual-value, and insurance evidence for stationary-storage channels.
title: Battery Passport Claims Bridge
uncertainties: Per-asset willingness to pay is untested.
The reachable distributor fleet size is unknown.
